Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.

POSTURE: perched on a ledge or edge.
SUPPORT: she sits on the edge, her weight on her hips.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body facing the camera; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
BOTH HANDS: both hands brace on the edge on either side of her hips.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one eye closed in a playful wink while the other stays open and bright, one mouth corner lifted in a small smile, brows relaxed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.
